notes: Chinese Whaley (Micro Whale) firmware, defunct brand (company folded ~2018-2020), no firmware updates since Dec 2018. 8 GB eMMC (7.28 GiB total: 1 G /system + 1 G OTA backup + 4.95 G /data + 64 M /cache + vendor partitions), 1 GB-class RAM class device. Stock home is com.helios.launcher. Voice chain is com.helios.voice -> com.iflytek.xiri (iFlytek); the remote voice key is bound to that private chain and CANNOT be re-bound without root - /system/usr/keylayout is stock but the framework hands KEYCODE_VOICE_ASSIST to the vendor chain. Verified with AdGuard Home DNS logs: the firmware phones home to *.aginomoto.com (ad., wlslog., u., member., appstore., kids., vod., passport., parse/parse2/parse3.), scs.openspeech.cn (iFlytek) and ic.tv.aliyun.com at 30+ queries/hour right from boot. Quirks, all checked on the TV: (1) `pm disable-user --user 0` from adb shell is REFUSED (java.lang.SecurityException, even for packages whose uid the shell does not own) - use `pm hide` instead, which works, survives reboot, and is reversible with `pm unhide`; (2) /data/app and other packages' data dirs are unreadable to the shell user (locked-down ROM, cannot measure per-app sizes); (3) the shell has no head/wc/grep -E on-device in some applets (limited toybox), pipe to the host instead; (4) `pm trim-caches` needs a suffixed value (1G - a bare number fails with 'Invalid suffix'); (5) overwrite-installs of a RUNNING app get cancelled ('Cancelled') - `am force-stop <pkg>` first; (6) /sdcard is empty on this unit (no adoptable storage, public cache dir falls back to internal). Safe to hide: 17 packages listed in debloat.txt. MUST STAY ENABLED: com.helios.launcher (stock home), com.helios.setting, com.helios.mediaplayer, com.helios.vod (launcher dependency), com.iflytek.xiri + com.helios.voice + com.helios.heliosvoice (remote voice key dead otherwise), com.yunos.* payment services (leave alone). Whaley-era appstores were already removed upstream by the firmware.
